mapper.insert: insert into bookmark(bookmark_member, bookmark_type, bookmark_target) values (#{bookmarkMember}, #{bookmarkType}, #{bookmarkTarget})
mapper.select: select b.bookmark_target as streamer_no, bs.streamer_name, bs.streamer_soop_id, ssl.official_ranking1, ssl.official_ranking2, ssl.official_ranking3, NVL(ck.play_count, 0) AS ck_play_count, NVL(ck.win_count, 0) AS ck_win_count, NVL(ck.lose_count, 0) AS ck_lose_count from bookmark b left outer join streamer bs on bs.streamer_no = b.bookmark_target left outer join streamer_stat_list ssl on ssl.streamer_no = b.bookmark_target left outer join( select ck_streamer, count(*) as play_count, sum(case when ck_result='승리' then 1 else 0 end) as win_count, sum(case when ck_result='패배' then 1 else 0 end) as lose_count from ck_list group by ck_streamer ) ck on ck.ck_streamer = b.bookmark_target where b.bookmark_member=#{memberId} and b.bookmark_type='streamer' order by b.bookmark_time desc

select tl.* from bookmark b left outer join tournament_list tl on tl.tournament_id = b.bookmark_target where b.bookmark_member=#{memberId} and b.bookmark_type='tournament' order by b.bookmark_time desc, tournament_year desc

WITH favorite_streamer AS ( SELECT bookmark_target FROM ( SELECT bookmark_target FROM bookmark WHERE bookmark_member = #{memberId} AND bookmark_type = 'streamer' ORDER BY bookmark_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5 ), ck_summary AS ( SELECT cl.ck_streamer, COUNT(*) AS play_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cl.ck_result = '승리' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count, SUM(CASE WHEN cl.ck_result = '패배' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lose_count FROM ck_list cl JOIN favorite_streamer fs ON fs.bookmark_target = cl.ck_streamer GROUP BY cl.ck_streamer ) SELECT fs.bookmark_target AS streamerNo, s.streamer_name AS streamerName, s.streamer_soop_id AS streamerSoopId,
NVL(ck.play_count, 0) AS totalPlayCount, NVL(ck.win_count, 0) AS totalWinCount, NVL(ck.lose_count, 0) AS totalLoseCount,
CASE WHEN NVL(ck.play_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(ck.win_count / ck.play_count * 100, 1) END AS totalWinRate
FROM favorite_streamer fs JOIN streamer s ON s.streamer_no = fs.bookmark_target LEFT OUTER JOIN ck_summary ck ON ck.ck_streamer = fs.bookmark_target

WITH favorite_streamer AS ( SELECT bookmark_target FROM ( SELECT bookmark_target FROM bookmark WHERE bookmark_member = #{memberId} AND bookmark_type = 'streamer' ORDER BY bookmark_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10 ), ranked_ck AS ( SELECT cl.ck_streamer AS streamer_no, CASE WHEN cl.ck_result = '승리' THEN 'W' ELSE 'L' END AS result, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cl.ck_streamer ORDER BY cl.ck_date DESC, cl.ck_id DESC ) AS rn FROM ck_list cl JOIN favorite_streamer fs ON fs.bookmark_target = cl.ck_streamer ) SELECT streamer_no AS streamerNo, result FROM ranked_ck WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY streamer_no, rn
